mission_05: Great work! You have implemented FeatureUnion to create rich, multi-perspective feature representations by processing the same input through parallel transformation branches. By combining scaled original features, polynomial expansions, and PCA-reduced features, your pipeline provides the classifier with complementary views of the data. FeatureUnion is particularly valuable when different transformations capture different aspects of the underlying patterns, such as local interactions (polynomial features) and global structure (PCA). The concatenated feature set gives the model more expressive power, though it requires careful management of feature dimensionality to avoid overfitting. This technique is widely used in feature engineering competitions and production systems where maximizing predictive power is critical.
